command: import json,subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(sys.argv[1:],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120); print(r.stdout,end=''); print(r.stderr,end=''); o=json.loads(r.stdout); assert r.returncode==1 and o['reason']=='learned evaluator did not improve held-out loss over initialization' and len(o['observed']['failed_learning_seeds'])==3 and o['observed']['all_checkpoints_independently_evaluated']==12; print(json.dumps({'actual_verifier_exit':r.returncode,'learning_gate':'FAILED','all_seed_provenance':'replayed'}))
